children: China banking giant's unaudited half-year net interest income rose nearly 9% yr/yr to RMB 341.2 bln
Net income attributable to equity holders increased about 3% yr/yr to RMB 173.7 bln
CET1 capital ratio reached 13.21% as of June 2026
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full yr in the press release
NET INTEREST INCOME GROWTH - Higher net interest income supported overall profit growth
FEE AND COMMISSION INCOME - Increased fee and commission income contributed to operating income
IMPAIRMENT LOSSES - Higher impairment losses on assets partially offset profit gains
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 14 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Ltd is HK$7.90, about 6% above its August 27 closing price of HK$7.46
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
